title: BUGFIX — generate-stats-report: fix TS2448 manualEntries used before declaration
rationale: Sprint 1338 added `const postsDelivered = manualEntries.length` on line 118, but `const manualEntries = readJsonLines(manualPath)` is declared on line 140. TypeScript TS2448 error: Block-scoped variable 'manualEntries' used before its declaration. The script crashes on ts-node compile, meaning stats-latest.json hasn't been regenerated since the fix. Fix: move the manualEntries declaration (and manualPath, postedIds, unposted, top3VideoIds block) above the gate calculation section, or inline the manual posts read earlier.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/generate-stats-report.ts: move `const manualPath = join(ROOT, ...); const manualEntries = readJsonLines(manualPath);` to BEFORE line 113 (the gate calculation section). Update all subsequent references to use the already-declared variable.
